name: Image Utilities (Pillow)
purpose: Deterministic image plumbing for one image: probe metadata (dims/format/mode/has_alpha/dpi/EXIF-lite), content + perceptual hashes (sha256 + pHash + dHash), resize (fit/fill/exact or a single max_dimension, reporting scale factors), crop (pixel rect / normalized / named region), convert (png/jpg/webp/bmp/tiff + quality), tile/split (grid or fixed size + overlap), and image similarity (Hamming distance of perceptual hashes). Runs a Pillow+numpy Python worker under the system python and reads its meta file (worker+meta hand-off). CPU-only, parallel-safe, no model. Unblocks ocr.layout's MaxImageDimension downscale-then-rescale-boxes and box-overlay follow-ons.

invocation.args_spec: Named params -InputFile <path> (required); -Op <meta|resize|crop|convert|tile|similarity> (default meta); resize: -Width -Height -Mode <fit|fill|exact> -MaxDimension -Resample <lanczos|bicubic|bilinear|box|hamming|nearest> -AllowUpscale; crop: -X -Y -CropWidth -CropHeight -Normalized -Region <center|top|bottom|left|right|top-left|top-right|bottom-left|bottom-right> -RegionFraction; convert/output: -Format <png|jpg|jpeg|webp|bmp|tiff> -Quality <1..100> -OutputName; tile: -TileCols -TileRows | -TileWidth -TileHeight -TileOverlap; similarity: -CompareTo <path>; hashing: -HashSize <n> -NoPerceptualHash; overrides -PythonPath -ImageWorkerPath. OR -InputsJson '<json {input,op,width,height,mode,max_dimension,resample,allow_upscale,x,y,crop_width,crop_height,normalized,region,region_fraction,format,quality,output_name,tile_cols,tile_rows,tile_width,tile_height,tile_overlap,compare_to,hash_size,no_perceptual_hash,python_path,image_worker_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Path to the source image (anything Pillow can open: png/jpg/webp/bmp/tif/gif/...).

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Operation: meta | resize | crop | convert | tile | similarity. Metadata + hashes are always computed regardless of op.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Target width (resize). With height depends on mode.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Target height (resize).

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Resize mode: fit (scale within WxH box, keep aspect, no upscale by default), fill (cover box + center-crop to exact WxH), exact (resize to WxH ignoring aspect).

inputs.name: max_dimension
inputs.description: Resize so the longest side is <= this, keeping aspect (the ocr.layout downscale case). Overrides width/height when set.

inputs.name: resample
inputs.description: Resampling filter: lanczos|bicubic|bilinear|box|hamming|nearest.

inputs.name: allow_upscale
inputs.description: Permit fit/max_dimension to enlarge an image smaller than the target.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: Crop left (px, or 0..1 fraction if normalized).

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: Crop top (px, or fraction if normalized).

inputs.name: crop_width
inputs.description: Crop width (px, or fraction if normalized).

inputs.name: crop_height
inputs.description: Crop height (px, or fraction if normalized).

inputs.name: normalized
inputs.description: Treat x/y/crop_width/crop_height as 0..1 fractions of the image.

inputs.name: region
inputs.description: Named crop region: center|top|bottom|left|right|top-left|top-right|bottom-left|bottom-right (used when no explicit rect is given).

inputs.name: region_fraction
inputs.description: Size of a named region as a fraction of the image (0..1).

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Output format for resize/crop/convert/tile: png|jpg|jpeg|webp|bmp|tiff. Default = keep the input format.

inputs.name: quality
inputs.description: Encoder quality 1..100 for jpg/webp.

inputs.name: output_name
inputs.description: Base name for output image files (default = input file stem).

inputs.name: tile_cols
inputs.description: Tile: number of columns (grid mode).

inputs.name: tile_rows
inputs.description: Tile: number of rows (grid mode).

inputs.name: tile_width
inputs.description: Tile: fixed tile width in px (size mode; takes precedence over cols/rows).

inputs.name: tile_height
inputs.description: Tile: fixed tile height in px (size mode).

inputs.name: tile_overlap
inputs.description: Tile: overlap between adjacent tiles in px.

inputs.name: compare_to
inputs.description: similarity: path to a second image to compare against by perceptual hash.

inputs.name: hash_size
inputs.description: Perceptual hash size (8 -> 64-bit).

inputs.name: no_perceptual_hash
inputs.description: Skip pHash/dHash (sha256 is always computed).
